story.festival_stars.name: Star festival
story.festival_stars.desc: A star-festival challenge: scan five bodies from orbit.
story.festival_stars.ch.c1.sum: The star festivals look up. Scan five planets or moons with the ship scanner.
story.festival_stars.r1.start: A star festival is on! Tonight people all over Earth look up at the sky. Look further: scan five planets or moons from orbit and I have starlight for your base.
story.festival_stars.graduated: Written in the stars. Cyan light strips and white lamps, like a night sky.
story.festival_stars.d1.start: Scan five planets or moons from orbit with the ship scanner.
story.festival_stars.d1.done: Five worlds charted. The stars are yours.
